# Blou

> Blou is a quit smoking app for iPhone that shows proof your body is healing: a photo timeline, lung (breath) checks, SOS craving help, personal insights, and every milestone on one visual timeline. It is a subscription app with a free trial; the app's features require an active subscription. iPhone only (iOS 17+); there is no Android version.

The website tryblou.com is free to use. It publishes plain-language quit-smoking guides, checked against public guidance from the NHS, CDC, US Surgeon General, and WHO. It does not replace medical advice.

## Start here
- [How to quit smoking: step-by-step plan](https://tryblou.com/how-to-quit-smoking)
- [Nicotine withdrawal timeline, days 1–30](https://tryblou.com/nicotine-withdrawal-timeline)
- [All guides: milestones and symptoms](https://tryblou.com/guides)

## Tools (free, run in the browser)
- [Money saved calculator](https://tryblou.com/tools/money-saved)
- [Lung recovery timeline](https://tryblou.com/tools/lung-recovery)
- [Cost of smoking calculators by country](https://tryblou.com/calculators)
